Rye — Spicier whiskey made from rye grain. Bolder and drier than bourbon.
Tequila — Made from agave plants in Mexico. Ranges from fresh and citrusy (blanco) to smooth and oak-aged (añejo).

Vodka — Clean, neutral spirit. Great for cocktails or sipping when high quality.
Gin — Flavored with botanicals (especially juniper). Herbal and aromatic, perfect for cocktails.
